candidates.title: How Great Is Our Claude: AI tools that evaluate the theology of worship songs
candidates.summary: Original reporting on SongTheology (Asaph's Table nonprofit) and Asaph, two Claude-powered tools that score worship lyrics on a seven-part theology grid (scriptural grounding, doctrinal clarity, God-centeredness, gospel presence, clarity, congregational usefulness, pastoral durability) and track theological balance across a church's setlists, with a researcher's caution that the tools must not shortcut reflection.

candidates.title: Wycliffe report: 807 languages now have a complete Bible
candidates.summary: Annual progress figures: 28 complete Bibles and 70 New Testaments launched in a year, about one every four days; Wycliffe credits local translators, advances in technology and church support.
candidates.whyNotChosen: Technology is one of three named causes but no specific technology is described; not tech-centered. Coverage also leans on country figures.
